name: How long does it take to install new pool equipment and automation?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new pool equipment and automation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for installing new pool equipment and automation depends on the project's scope. For a standard residential pool with essential equipment (pump, filter, heater) and a basic automation system, installation can typically be completed within 2 to 5 days. However, more extensive projects involving complex water features, elaborate lighting, or significant plumbing modifications may take longer. Our team will provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific pool design and equipment selections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 2-5 days for standard residential pools with essential equipment and basic automation, but complex projects may require more time.
